data.body:
[P2] Roll back hold intents when the pre-dispatch save fails

If this initial save raises, `put_object()` has not run, but the hold remains `PENDING` in `control_records` and is absent from `self.gates`. `SharedAdapter.start()` consequently retains the case, `release_all()` skips the gate, and `delete_controls()` rejects the unresolved hold. Even a transient local write failure before any invocation prevents retirement and retains the persistent target fence, blocking subsequent cases and runs. Roll back this definitively undispatched hold, reconciling any persisted receipt. Add a regression that fails this save once and verifies no S3/Invoke dispatch and successful no-work retirement.
